column1: # Star Fox (Switch 2): the survey's profile (scripts/build_ipa_from_nsp.py, dm/games/profile_guess.py), with the memory layout, net and the resolution cut of the bring-up (README.md)
# not loaded, main takes nothing from them the host does not supply: subsdk1 (C / libc), subsdk2 (NintendoSDK_DLSS)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main never sets a heap: the game maps its memory itself. The survey's 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias
# region ran out at the renderer's 3 GB block (vrender_create, Out of memory); an 80 GB block with a 48 GB alias region, as Kirby Air Riders needed
# the sdk is built for the Switch 2 (spec: Ounce): its 9 GB pool
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# its libuv makes a loopback socket pair to start (main+0xbe32700), which the offline socket layer cannot give: real host sockets (README.md, Sockets)
# the game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode with near = 0 in the check boot: the pipeline bases made before it runs are made for that mode
# address regions: 2026-11-03, no address regions (rewrite b56c6be9c44f)
